d: Smarter swap rebalancing — skipping a workout now offered to replace an upcoming session
det: Intermediate version before the full auto-cascade in v1.25. When skipping a gym day, the app offered two options: move the workout to a free rest day, or replace a different upcoming gym session with the missed type. This was replaced in v1.25 with fully automatic cascading.

d: Your Activities card moved to My Training tab — activities and goals now live together
det: The Your Activities card was previously in Settings. Moved it to the My Training tab so all your training setup — goals, activities, PRs — lives in one place. Settings is now purely about configuration (AI coach, gym, Strava, account).

d: Progress and Settings split into separate tabs — cleaner navigation
det: The old Progress tab was getting crowded — it had PRs, history, goals, AND settings all mixed in. Split into My Training (PRs, history, goals, activities) and Settings (AI coach, gym profile, Strava, account, What's New). The bottom nav now has three tabs: Plan, My Training, Settings.

d: App loads faster — service worker caching for instant return visits, Firebase scripts deferred
det: Added a service worker (sw.js) that caches the app shell on first visit. Every return visit loads instantly from cache and updates in the background. Also moved Firebase scripts to deferred loading so they don't block the initial render — Firebase only initialises after the page is ready.

d: Strava auto-syncs on app open if last sync was over 1 hour ago — no manual tap needed
det: On every app open, checks the timestamp of the last Strava sync. If it was more than 60 minutes ago and you have a valid Strava token, a background sync runs automatically. Ride data is always fresh without you having to remember to tap Sync.

d: Edit PR sheet spacing fixed — better padding and breathing room around inputs
det: The edit PR bottom sheet had inputs sitting too close to the card edges. Fixed padding on all sides so the sheet is comfortable to use on small screens.

d: Rest day swap now offers to move the workout to another rest day to keep your weekly goal on track
det: Early version of the rebalancing logic. When swapping a workout to rest, the app checked for other rest days in the same week and offered to slot the workout there. Evolved into the full cascade in v1.22 and v1.25.

d: Goals are now multi-select; biological sex question added to onboarding; skip option on every step
det: Previously you could only pick one goal (e.g. Build muscle OR Lose weight). Now you can select multiple. Biological sex was added so the app can tailor coaching — only Male and Female options. Every onboarding step now has a Skip option so you're never forced to answer before you're ready.

d: Strava connect now shows a success toast with ride count; error toast if connection fails
det: After Strava OAuth completes, the app now shows a green toast confirming how many rides were synced, or a red toast with the error message if something went wrong. Previously there was no feedback at all.

d: Goals onboarding — set your activities and goal; non-cyclists no longer get bike days in their plan
det: Added the goals setup flow: pick your activities, training days per week, experience level, and goals. The weekly plan generator now checks your selected activities — if cycling isn't in your list, no ride days appear in your plan.

d: Coach Says fetches all 4 mood notes in one API call — switching energy is now instant with zero extra calls
det: Previously each energy level tap (Fresh/Okay/Tired/Sore) triggered a new API call. Now the app fetches all four mood variants in a single call on page load and caches them. Switching how you feel is instant and uses no extra quota.

d: Coach Says skips the API entirely for new users with no training data — shows a personalised explainer instead
det: New users with no logged workouts got a generic or broken AI response. Now the app detects no training history and shows a built-in welcome message instead of wasting an API call.

d: Exercise Coach tips hardcoded for all 61 exercises — instant, works offline, zero API usage
det: Exercise-specific coaching tips (connection cue, setup, rep execution, what to avoid, today's focus) are now baked into the app for all 61 exercises. No API call needed — tips appear instantly and work with no internet.

d: AI fallback chain added — Gemini → Perplexity → OpenAI so coaching never goes down when quota is hit
det: The Cloudflare Worker now tries three AI providers in order: Gemini 2.5 Flash first, then Perplexity Sonar if Gemini hits its quota (429), then GPT-4o-mini if Perplexity also fails. All responses are normalised to the same format so the app never knows which provider responded.

d: Login fixed to support real Gmail addresses; Forgot Password button added
det: Firebase email auth was rejecting some valid Gmail addresses due to a validation bug. Fixed. Also added a Forgot Password button that triggers Firebase's password reset email flow.

d: Edit PR modal overhauled — live lb↔kg conversion, current PR shown, better layout
det: The edit PR sheet now shows your current PR value at the top, supports live unit conversion as you type (switch between kg and lb), and has a cleaner layout with proper spacing.

d: iOS PWA: install to home screen, correct app icon, social share preview image added
det: Added the apple-touch-icon so the correct icon appears when you add the app to your iPhone home screen. Also added Open Graph meta tags so sharing the link shows a proper preview image instead of a blank card.

d: Exercise Coach overhauled — 5-section muscle-activation guide: Connect, Setup, Rep, Avoid, Today
det: Replaced the single-paragraph coach tip with a structured 5-section breakdown for every exercise: muscle connection cue, setup position, rep execution, common mistakes to avoid, and a session-specific focus based on your energy level and PRs.

d: Coach Says introduced — AI pre-workout note personalised to energy level and PR history via Gemini
det: Added the Coach Says card on the workout day screen. It sends your energy level, current PRs, and workout type to Gemini and returns a short personalised coaching note. Cached per session so it doesn't re-fetch on every render.

d: Energy selector (Fresh / Okay / Tired / Sore) added — exercises and coach adapt to how you feel
det: Added a 4-state energy selector at the top of each workout day. The AI coach adjusts its tone and advice based on your selection. Tired/Sore states also show a reduced-intensity note on the session.

d: Strava integration — sync real ride data, gym profile picker, bike setup wizard
det: Full Strava OAuth flow via Cloudflare Worker (keeps client secret off the device). Syncs recent rides and displays them in the plan. Added a gym picker with live search across a database of gyms, home gym equipment list, and a bike setup wizard with event target date and peak/taper periodisation.

d: Cycling planner added — weather-based outdoor/indoor day selection, Zone 2 ride blocks
det: Added cycling days to the weekly plan. The app fetches weather for your location and recommends outdoor vs indoor based on temperature and rain. Ride sessions are Zone 2 blocks with progressive duration scaling across the week.

d: Exercise cards with GIF animations, collapse/expand, and muscle group banners added
det: Added animated GIF demos to every exercise card. Cards collapse by default to keep the session view clean and expand on tap. Muscle group colour banners (Push/Pull/Legs) added to each session header.

d: Google Sign-In via Firebase replaced GitHub Gist sync — no setup required, works across devices
det: Replaced the original GitHub Gist sync (which required a personal access token) with Firebase Auth + Realtime Database. Sign in with Google in one tap, data syncs automatically across all your devices.

d: Guest preview mode added — try the app without signing up, with sample data throughout
det: Added a guest mode that pre-loads sample PRs, a sample weekly plan, and lets you explore all features without creating an account. Guest mode never makes API calls and never writes to the database.

d: PIN lock screen added — app locks on close, auto-unlocks on PWA open if no PIN is set
det: Added an optional 4-digit PIN that locks the app when you close it. If no PIN is set, the app opens straight to the plan. PIN is stored locally and never sent to any server.

d: kg / lb toggle added — switch units in the log modal, all weights convert automatically
det: Added a unit toggle in the set logging modal. Switching between kg and lb converts all displayed weights in real time. Preference is saved and applied globally across PRs and logging.

d: Workout history added — last 90 days of sessions; export and import backup for your data
det: Added a workout history view showing the last 90 days of logged sessions with exercise count and sets. Also added export (downloads a JSON backup) and import (restores from a JSON file) for full data portability.

d: Per-exercise swap added — change any exercise mid-workout when machines are busy
det: Added a Swap button on every exercise card during a session. Tapping it shows alternative exercises for the same muscle slot — so if the bench press is taken you can switch to dumbbell press without leaving the workout.

d: Inline set logging added — track weight × reps for every set with a done checkbox
det: Added set-by-set logging directly on the exercise cards. Each set has weight, reps, and a done checkbox. Completed sets are highlighted and counted. Data saves automatically to localStorage and Firebase on each tap.

d: Change Workout button added to day screen — swap to a different workout type on the fly
det: Added the Swap button to the day view. Lets you switch the day's workout type (e.g. Push → Pull) without going back to the weekly plan. The session regenerates immediately with the new type.

d: Initial build — weather-driven weekly planner, Push / Pull / Legs splits, exercise library, and PR tracking
det: First working version. Weekly plan generated based on number of training days. Push/Pull/Legs splits with a fixed exercise library. Weather fetched from Open-Meteo and used to pick outdoor vs indoor days. PR tracking with localStorage persistence.
